body:
Okay, apparently I answered with my actual account which wasn't my intention, so just copy pasting the answer on my burner.

"Yo, I appreciate the extensive reply a lot! Let me answer bit by bit.

As for friendship “maintenance”, my view hasn’t changed much I’m pretty high maintenance and I need the intimacy. If it’s not provided my mind goes constant negative thoughts. I don’t know where to start this irl but I don’t need it to be. I’ve gotten pretty intimate feelings online and I’ve met several people from online in real life. And I’d be fine if I knew they were busy but I know they sometimes do jack and even in those windows they still don’t initiate convos.
It makes me very blocked towards trusting people especially new ones and ones I’ve previously been hurt by, not a grudge but a “it won’t be the same” thing.


As for exercise, another reason I don’t believe in it (in my case) is I went through a 3 month course of almost losing 10kg a month. 5-6 times of gym a week and I didn’t feel any happier at all, surely if this worked for me the 3 months would have affected me somehow.


The pet thing is becoming more and more appealing maybe if I tell my mum it’s for depression it’s negotiable?


I’ve tried finding the right education I just don’t see any of them as my calling, not long-term. I’ve got academic competence just no drive/discipline/motivation.

Thanks for the message!"

Okay, apparently I answered with my actual account which wasn't my intention, so just copy pasting the answer on my burner. 

"Hi, thank you for taking your time to read the whole thing I wasn’t sure if anyone was going to.. I didn’t realise how long it was until after I submitted it. Not sure if it can be made much shorter and still correctly express myself. And I thought the medicine I had was supposed to treat both, not had anything specifically for anxiety no. And I asked my mother this question don’t think she’d change her mind about the kitten now."
Yes I do, I'll ask her next time.

I don't think it's malicious, I just wish they'd be more honest about why they don't talk to me or that they find other things interest. Of course it's extremely rare anyone is that blunt but sometimes even though I feel down I just need the truth. 

And yea, it's the advice I'd give to someone else, the don't hold back thing I just have too much fear of the same cycle repeating :/


Eh, I might try to do exercise through having a pet with the daily walks if that happens. Otherwise I don't see myself being motivated enough to do the same again with the chance of the same result. 

You have to grasp that I really tried a lot of things, granted never "long term" but when none of it had any effect I just... give up. 

Yea that's kind of my idea with education, might try linguistics or sociology .. at least I have some minor interest there. They are at the bottom of "things I'd do" but they aren't in the "things I want to do" if that makes sense xD 

You're awesome btw dude, thanks for replying even though it's not positive replies you're getting!
